content: Part of the Wugweb Skill System. Plan stage only. Nothing goes to development until the owner says. ## Skill card | Field | Value | | --- | --- | | Name | wugweb-voice | | Type | Claude Code project skill (Agent Skill) | | Version | 0.1.0 (planned) | | Status | Plan in progress | | Planned in session | wugweb-voice | | Will live at | .claude/skills/wugweb-voice/ | ## What it owns How Wugweb writes and speaks. One voice: the owner says his voice and Wugweb's are the same. It covers vocabulary and phrasing, sentence structure, length and cadence, formality and punctuation, and variants by context (quick chat, formal document, spoken answer). ## What it does not own - Personality, beliefs or decision style. It must not guess these from how the owner writes. - Client voices. Those stay with each case study. - Identity and positioning (wugweb-brand-os). ## Rules already fixed - Calibrated only on writing the owner supplies or authorises, with a record of which samples were used. - Typos are not copied. - British English, sentence case, no em or en dashes, no filler words, nothing invented. - Before and after examples, a stated confidence, and blind comparison against real samples. ## Starting material The "Writing style and tone" section of the wugweb-work plan. It is a draft written from the owner's decisions and research, not yet reviewed by him as his voice. ## Helper skills rampstack-seo:content-and-copy, copywriting-kit:copy-edit, copywriting-kit:copy-diagnose, copywriting-kit:brand-voice, design:ux-copy, brand-voice:brand-voice-enforcement, brand-voice:guideline-generation, marketing:brand-review. They return proposals only. ## Hands off to and from | With | Gives | Takes | | --- | --- | --- | | wugweb-brand-os | The voice rules brand-os points to | Identity and positioning | | wugweb-work, wugweb-content, social | The voice for every piece of copy | Draft text to check | ## Waiting on the owner - [ ] Approved writing samples (none supplied yet). - [ ] Confirm the "one voice" reading. - [ ] Where working preferences (how he reasons, gives feedback) should live, since they are not voice. ## Plan Being written in the skill's session. It is added here once the owner approves it.
